items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: Nicholas, you know, can go into Ryan's session or wherever there's a New York session with, uh, any kind of swing musicians and play and fit in perfectly.

ctx.x: Uh, well, uh, they had been around New York, uh, and more in touch with the day-to-day, uh, situations in music, uh, you know, more than, than, uh, these other fellows had. And, uh, and they, I guess had, uh, in their playing, arrived at more of a, a style that fits in with the New York scene, as well as, as, uh, their own, uh, tastes in playing. In other words, uh, Nicholas, uh, Nicholas, you know, can go into Ryan's session or wherever there's a New York session with, uh, any kind of swing musicians and play…
Oh, did you ever work with him?
